definitions.explanation: A medical examination to check for diseases or health conditions, often as a preventive measure.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}{検診|けんしん}を{受|う}ける。
{年|ねん}に{一度|いちど}のがん{検診|けんしん}は{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: An annual cancer screening is important.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}の{検診|けんしん}で{異常|いじょう}が{見|み}つかった。
examples.english: An abnormality was found during the company health screening.

notes:
VERB FORM:
{検診|けんしん}する - to examine, screen (medical)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{健康|けんこう}{検診|けんしん} - health checkup
・がん{検診|けんしん} - cancer screening
・{歯科|しか}{検診|けんしん} - dental checkup
・{乳|にゅう}がん{検診|けんしん} - breast cancer screening
・{検診|けんしん}を{受|う}ける - to have a checkup
・{検診|けんしん}の{結果|けっか} - checkup results

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{健康診断|けんこうしんだん} ({健診|けんしん}) - health examination (broader)
・{人間ドック|にんげんドック} - comprehensive medical examination
